properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EWALA mu Buyudaaya,
Eriyo-olusozi,
Kwe yatufiirira Yesu,
Ye Mukama waffe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ffe-abantu be tetumanyi
Ennaku bwe zaali,
Ze yalaba ku lw'abantu,
-Omulokozi Yesu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yafa ffe tufune-eddembe
Atuwe n'obulamu:
Yafa atutuuse-ewuwe
Gy'atudde mu ggulu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tewali-eyandiyinzizza
Kulokola munne,
Newankubadde ye yekka
Kusinga-omusango.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mukama y'ayinza yekka
Okutuggulira
Oluggi olw'omu ggulu,
N'okutuyingiza.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tusaanidde ffe twagale
Mukama waffe-oyo;
Tweweeyo-okumuweereza
Eyatufiirira
